title: Preference Optimization for Non-Verbal Vocalization Synthesis
abstract: arXiv:2608.24163v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Non-verbal vocalizations (NVs), such as laughter, coughs, and sighs, are essential for expressive TTS, but the effectiveness of preference optimization for NV generation remains poorly understood. We systematically study preference optimization for NV-capable TTS, focusing on preference signals, preference-pair construction, and DPO-based optimization objectives. We formulate an NV-aware character error rate (NV-CER) by treating NV tags as distinct output symbols and computing a weighted pinyin-based CER over both verbal and non-verbal content, enabling controllable optimization of NV realization without modifying the underlying optimization algorithm. Experiments on Emilia-NV and the augmented NV-Bench covering 18 NV types reveal how different design choices affect NV realization and lexical fidelity, and establish an effective setup using standard DPO. translated_title: 非语言发声合成的偏好优化
translated_abstract: 非语言发声（NVs），如笑声、咳嗽和叹息，对于富有表现力的文本转语音（TTS）至关重要，但偏好优化在NV生成中的有效性仍未被充分理解。我们系统研究了针对支持NV的TTS的偏好优化，重点关注偏好信号、偏好对构建以及基于DPO的优化目标。我们通过将NV标签视为独立的输出符号，并在语言和非语言内容上计算基于拼音的加权字符错误率，提出了一种NV感知的字符错误率（NV-CER），从而在不修改底层优化算法的情况下，实现对NV实现的可控优化。在Emilia-NV和覆盖18种NV类型的增强版NV-Bench上进行的实验，揭示了不同设计选择如何影响NV实现和词汇保真度，并建立了一种使用标准DPO的有效设置。客观评估、基于LLM的评估和人工评估为我们的发现提供了收敛性证据。
tldr: 本文提出了一种NV感知的字符错误率（NV-CER）方法，在不改变优化算法的情况下，通过偏好优化有效提升非语言发声合成的可控性和保真度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an NV-aware character error rate (NV-CER) method that enables controllable and faithful non-verbal vocalization synthesis via preference optimization without altering the underlying algorithm.
